items.title: A flat module of finite presentation is locally a direct summand of a finite free module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a flat module of finite presentation on a ringed space is locally a direct summand of a finite free module (author lemma at source lines 3153-3158, label lemma-flat-locally-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 3160-3188) starts from a local presentation of the module, applies the flatness criterion repeatedly to peel off the summands of the module of relations one at a time, and ends with a free module through which the surjection factors with the composite of the relation map vanishing, which exhibits a section (proof lines 3167-3187). The iteration peeling off the relations is the content; the criterion applied at each step is a navigation-pointer stub. H2.
